listeners.description: SSH listener specifications (IP address + port). Leave address empty to bind to all interfaces.

address.description: IP address to bind to (empty string = all interfaces)

rsa_key_path.description: Path to custom RSA host key (e.g., /etc/dropbear/dropbear_rsa_host_key)

dss_key_path.description: Path to custom DSS host key (e.g., /etc/dropbear/dropbear_dss_host_key)

ecdsa_key_path.description: Path to custom ECDSA host key (e.g., /etc/dropbear/dropbear_ecdsa_host_key)

disable_password_auth.description: If true, only SSH key authentication is allowed (strongly recommended for security)

allow_root_login.description: If true, permit direct root login via SSH (security risk—usually disabled)

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before terminating session (0 = no timeout)

max_auth_tries.description: Maximum authentication attempts per connection before disconnect

banner_path.description: Path to banner file shown before authentication (e.g., /etc/issue.net)

enable_legacy_ciphers.description: If true, allow legacy ciphers (e.g., aes128-cbc only); otherwise use modern ciphers

ciphers_list.description: List of allowed ciphers when enable_legacy_ciphers is true

enable_legacy_kex.description: If true, allow legacy key exchange algorithms (not recommended)

kex_list.description: List of allowed KEX algorithms when enable_legacy_kex is true

enable_legacy_macs.description: If true, allow legacy MACs (not recommended)

macs_list.description: List of allowed MAC algorithms when enable_legacy_macs is true

allow_tcp_forwarding.description: If true, allow SSH TCP port forwarding (tunneling); disable for hardened setups

allow_x11_forwarding.description: If true, allow X11 forwarding (typically unnecessary for headless servers)

allow_agent_forwarding.description: If true, allow SSH agent forwarding (security-sensitive—disable unless required)

forced_command.description: Command to execute for all sessions (e.g., /bin/rbash); overrides user shell

keepalive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive packets; 0 disables keepalive
